subject.title: fix(cron): default deleteAfterRun for isolated cron jobs

question: Should OpenClaw support recurring isolated cron jobs with `deleteAfterRun` cleanup, or should recurring `deleteAfterRun` be rejected as a one-shot-only lifecycle flag?
rationale: The current PR and the related strict-validation PR encode opposite product contracts, and automation cannot safely choose the cron lifecycle semantics for existing users.

options.title: Support recurring isolated cleanup
options.body: Keep this direction, but require persisted-job upgrade handling and coverage so existing omitted isolated jobs are cleaned up after upgrade.

options.title: Reject recurring delete-after-run
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue through the strict-validation path after callers, UI defaults, docs, and legacy recovery are reconciled.

options.title: Accept fresh-create-only scope
options.body: Allow this PR to change only newly normalized jobs and document that existing omitted jobs need operator action or a separate migration.

recommendation.title: Support recurring isolated cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep this direction, but require persisted-job upgrade handling and coverage so existing omitted isolated jobs are cleaned up after upgrade.
